edits.html: Emphysema in a teenager Barrel chest and severe hyperinflation at 16 — early emphysema in a heavy smoker; emphysema this young suggests alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency · Mechanism — too little alpha-1 antitrypsin leaves neutrophil elastase unopposed; emphysema is panlobular and worst at the bases · Liver — misfolded protein retained in hepatocytes causes neonatal cholestasis and later cirrhosis · Clubbing — not a feature of COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) or alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency; in a child it points to cystic fibrosis or bronchiectasis
edits.note: Q10 teaching points: emphysema in an adolescent, mechanism, liver, clubbing as a misfit

edits.html: How NBME framed it The lead-in asks for a plain diagnosis, but the likeliest one, severe asthma in a smoker, is not offered; the past asthma admissions distract. The options are a family of rare lung disorders with the common answer left out, plus a planted sign, clubbing, that fits Kartagener syndrome better than the key.
edits.note: Q10 framing: stem hides the answer; construction pattern from sort.md

edits.html:
Congenital lobar emphysema: tempts with the word emphysema and the hyperinflation; it presents in a newborn or infant as one overinflated lobe, not bilateral hyperinflation at 16.
Kartagener syndrome: tempts with thick yellow sputum and clubbing; there is no situs inversus, chronic sinusitis or lifelong wet cough.
Pulmonary sequestration: tempts as a congenital lung lesion; it causes recurrent pneumonia in one lobe with a mass on the film, and this film shows only hyperinflation.
Sarcoidosis: tempts as a chronic lung disease of young people; the film has no hilar adenopathy or infiltrates.
edits.note: Q10 one trapline per NBME distractor

edits.stem: 16 yo who has smoked 1.5 packs daily for 4 years, with asthma admissions in childhood, now productive cough, barrel chest, mild clubbing, end-expiratory wheeze and severe bilateral hyperinflation as the only chest x-ray finding
edits.companion: confirm with a serum alpha-1 antitrypsin level
